vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1416 — fix triage subscribe reconciliation hint

plan.title: triage:subscribe reconciliation hint references bogus --resume flag

narratives.Description: After `task triage:subscribe` or unsubscribe, the CLI prints a reconciliation hint pointing at `task triage:bootstrap -- --resume`, but bootstrap does not accept `--resume`. Operators hit a hard failure when following the documented next step.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit `RECONCILE_HINT` in `packages/core/src/triage/subscribe/index.ts` and the CLI surface in `packages/cli/src/triage-subscribe.ts` so the post-subscribe hint references a bootstrap command that exists (drop bogus `--resume`).
2. Add or extend tests in `packages/core/src/triage/subscribe/index.test.ts` asserting the hint string matches a runnable bootstrap invocation.
3. Run `pnpm -w exec vitest run packages/core/src/triage/subscribe/index.test.ts` as verification evidence; add CHANGELOG entry.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator configuring triage scope, I want the post-subscribe reconciliation hint to reference a command that actually exists, so that I can reconcile cached entries without hitting argparse errors.

narrative.Acceptance: Given `task triage:subscribe` completes, when stderr reconciliation hint is printed, then the suggested command is accepted by triage bootstrap (no unrecognized `--resume`).
Given unit/CLI tests for triage subscribe, when run, then they assert the reconciliation hint matches the supported bootstrap invocation.
Given the fix lands, when `task check` runs, then it exits 0.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: Small CLI hint fix from ingested issue #1416.
